reconstruction_policy: Use saved predecessor state, standing orders, resources, opposition, exact events, stable seed, and prior receipts. Never award unsupported success or make Tang Wei choices.

safe_compaction_policy: A span receipt may cover multiple intervals only when each interval is internally processed in order and material interruptions split the span.
